tasks.short: Set requirements for cameras, motion detection, and installation.

steps.what: Design requirements for video surveillance and motion detection
Implement the installation and operation on site

outputs: filed copy of signed camera requirements v1

tasks.design: Designing and establishing requirements for security systems, video surveillance, motion detection, and closed-circuit television, and implementing the installation and operation, stays with the specialist. A job files the requirements in {DOCS} only after they sign them. The job does not watch a camera or recognize a face.
tasks.previous_blocker: A camera layout could be treated as installed, or as a way to score people.
tasks.enabler_now: A signed requirement can be filed for the installer.
tasks.still_hard: Where a camera may look, and whether the install is right, is still decided on the site.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist sets the requirements and signs them.
tasks.altitude: The design and the install stay. Filing the signed requirements shrinks.

reach.learn: That the file does not watch the cameras

evidence.claim: Digest [S19] bans emotion recognition at work since 2 February 2025, so a recording is not scored for how a person looks or sounds.
Digest [S22] says a data protection assessment is mandatory for employee monitoring, so an automated watch of named staff is not built.
Digest [S23] says works-council consent is required before staff monitoring, so this design does not add a view of named staff.
Digest [S20] bars a solely automated decision with significant effect, so a finding about a person stays with the specialist.

assumptions: No face or emotion score is produced.
The job does not operate the cameras.
A staff-monitoring view is a separate consent decision and is not built.
research_questions: How often a camera sees a place the requirement did not name.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the design is the site judgement, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the stored standard list or the drawing index when it changes, and clear drafts the specialist rejects.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes the specialist still sets every camera requirement. The high end assumes only the signed requirements are no longer copied. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare and update security procedures and drawings.

steps.what: Maintain security system drawings and related documentation
File the signed procedures and drawings
outputs: filed copy of signed procedure set v1

tasks.design: Preparing, maintaining, and updating security procedures, security system drawings, and related documentation stays with the specialist in {DOCS}. A job files that set only after they sign it.
tasks.previous_blocker: A generated drawing could replace the one the specialist maintains.
tasks.enabler_now: A signed set can be filed as the current version.
tasks.still_hard: What the drawing should show is still the specialist's judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist updates the set and signs it.

ambition.what: File a new signed set the same week a procedure changes.

tasks.altitude: The update stays. Filing the signed set shrinks.

evidence.claim: The operations digest says a draft must work from approved sources, and a named person signs.

assumptions: The job does not draw or rewrite the procedure.
research_questions: How often the site no longer matches the drawing.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the update is the editing itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the stored standard list or the drawing index when it changes, and clear drafts the specialist rejects.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes the specialist still edits every change. The high end assumes only the signed set is no longer copied. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare documentation for case reports or court proceedings.

steps.what: Prepare the case report from the specialist's notes
Draft court documentation from stored records

loop.purpose: Draft a case sentence only from the specialist's notes and a stored record id.
loop.input: The notes and the stored case records.
loop.output: A documentation draft that cites a record id.
loop.check: Every record id and every quotation matches the stored note.
loop.stop: Stop when a sentence has no record id.
loop.why_not_simpler: A template cannot tell which note belongs in a court pack.

steps.what: Decide what may go into the proceedings

outputs: filed copy of signed court documentation v1

tasks.design: The specialist prepares the case report. A bounded draft in {DOCS} may phrase court documentation only from their notes and stored record ids. They decide what may enter the proceedings, sign that version, and a job files it. A sentence with no record id is dropped. The draft is not a finding about a person.
tasks.previous_blocker: A generated pack could cite a record that does not exist, or accuse someone.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored notes can be quoted if the id matches.
tasks.still_hard: What a court should see is still the specialist's judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist signs the documentation and remains responsible for it.
tasks.altitude: The decision stays. Citing a stored record shrinks.

evidence.claim: Digest [S27] records that a model-drafted report cited sources that did not exist, so every cited clause or record must match a stored row.
Digest [S20] bars a solely automated decision with significant effect, so a finding about a person stays with the specialist.
The operations digest says a draft must work from approved sources, and a named person signs.

assumptions: The draft is not the case.
The job does not name a responsible person.
unknowns: Who else must review a court pack.
research_questions: How often a note has no record id.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the report is the specialist's own preparation.

incremental.description: Update the stored standard list or the drawing index when it changes, and clear drafts the specialist rejects.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes every sentence is still checked against a stored record. The high end assumes only a sentence with no record id comes back. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Develop conceptual designs of security systems

outputs: filed copy of signed conceptual design v1

tasks.design: Developing conceptual designs of security systems stays with the specialist in {DOCS}. A job files the design only after they sign it. The job does not turn the concept into an installation.
tasks.previous_blocker: A generated layout could be treated as the concept.
tasks.enabler_now: A signed concept can be filed for review.
tasks.still_hard: The concept is still the specialist's design.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist develops the design and signs it.
tasks.altitude: The design stays. Filing the signed concept shrinks.

evidence.claim: The operations digest says a draft must work from approved sources, and a named person signs.

assumptions: Nothing is built from this file.
research_questions: How often the concept changes after a walk.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the concept is the design itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the stored standard list or the drawing index when it changes, and clear drafts the specialist rejects.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes the concept is still drawn by the specialist. The high end assumes only the signed concept is no longer copied. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

role.altitude: The security specialist spends the week on the site, the incident, and the decision. Filing a signed note can move. No model scores a person, watches staff, or changes a live security system.
reach: A client sees only the criteria or the finding the specialist signed.
A supervisor gets an emergency note after the specialist has already responded.
skills_to_grow: Tell a stored incident count from a threat decision.
Refuse a view that scores or tracks named staff.
role.ambitious_version: A signed test or a signed recommendation can be filed the same day, and the specialist still decides it.
